title: Analista de Growth Pleno — Jornada do Cliente & Conversão (ChatBot WhatsApp)
description:
Vaga para modelo de contratação PJ


Remoto


A ConCrédito é uma das maiores correspondentes bancárias do Brasil, especializada em crédito consignado nas modalidades CLT, INSS e FGTS. Com mais de 300 mil clientes atendidos via WhatsApp, a ConCrédito preza pelo bom atendimento e pela experiência do cliente, comprovados pelas mais de 21 mil avaliações positivas no Google Meu Negócio.


O Papel

O Analista de Growth Pleno será o principal responsável pela jornada do cliente no chatbot do WhatsApp, o maior canal de aquisição e relacionamento da empresa. A missão é clara: reduzir atrito, combater o abandono e maximizar o Lifetime Value (LTV) da base de leads e clientes.


Responsabilidades

  • Mapear e otimizar o funil conversacional de ponta a ponta, identificando gargalos nas micro e macroconversões.
  • Rodar testes A/B contínuos em mensagens, copywriting, timing de follow-ups e arquitetura dos fluxos.
  • Criar e gerir réguas de relacionamento, ativação de leads frios e campanhas de reengajamento.
  • Auxiliar na construção de dashboards de acompanhamento da jornada em parceria com o time de Dados (Snowflake, Power BI).
  • Refinar clusters de audiência para personalização em escala.
  • Atuar de forma cross-functional com os times de Marketing, Vendas, BI e Produto/Tech.


KPIs sob sua gestão

  • Ativação: taxa de ativação de leads recém-chegados ao chatbot.
  • Conversão do funil: eficiência na passagem entre etapas do fluxo conversacional.
  • Taxa de abandono: redução de drop-off em cada estágio da jornada.
  • Time-to-convert: redução do tempo médio para contratação efetiva.
  • Retenção e recompra: aumento do LTV e da frequência de uso dos serviços.
  • ROI de campanhas: retorno sobre campanhas de repescagem e disparos via WhatsApp.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Capacidade técnica de uso ou criação de agentes de IA, independentemente da ferramenta ou framework (Claude, Manus, Antigravity…).
  • Experiência sólida como Analista de Growth, CRO, Lifecycle Marketing, CRM ou Produto, com foco em conversão.
  • Capacidade analítica avançada: métricas de funil, análise de cohort, LTV e CAC.
  • Vivência prática com otimização de chatbots, automação de mensagens e WhatsApp API oficial.
  • Domínio de frameworks de growth hacking e testes A/B.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados.
  • Boa comunicação para influenciar stakeholders técnicos e de negócios.


Diferenciais valorizados

  • Experiência prévia em fintechs, mercado de crédito ou operações B2C com alto volume de leads.
  • Conhecimento na plataforma ColmeIA ou chats conversacionais similares.
  • Habilidades em SQL e ferramentas como Metabase ou Supabase.
  • Familiaridade com IA aplicada à personalização de fluxos conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento em automação com N8N.


Essa vaga NÃO é para você se:

  • Você é mais executor do que estrategista e não tem experiência otimizando funis de conversão.
  • Sua experiência está focada em social media, branding ou marketing de conteúdo.
  • Você trabalha apenas com análise de dados, sem transformar insights em ações práticas.
  • Sua atuação em growth é mais teórica do que prática (cursos, conceitos, pouca execução real).
  • Você nunca lidou com alto volume de leads ou operações em escala.
  • Seu foco é apenas aquisição (tráfego pago) e não conversão ao longo da jornada.
  • Você não tem experiência com chatbots, automação de mensagens ou fluxos conversacionais.
  • Você precisa de direcionamento constante e não tem autonomia para testar, iterar e tomar decisões.

title: Product Marketing Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own our product-led growth in partnership with our product team — someone who knows how to move the needle and own their outcomes.


About us:


Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. Our SaaS products power tens of millions of conversations monthly, helping real estate professionals close more deals using text and voice.


If you’re used to depending on task queues, waiting for someone to tell you what to do, or only being reactive instead of mostly proactive — this isn’t the role for you.


But if you have a bias for execution and love taking ownership of outcomes — keep reading.


What You’ll Own


  • Drive our PLG initiatives by building campaigns that increase conversions, engagement, retention, upgrades, and cross-sells.
  • Own in-app messaging using tools like AppCues to onboard, convert, and activate users
  • Write high-impact messaging, value propositions, and product comparison landing pages that drive inbound conversion
  • Own and optimize in-app customer self-onboarding — reduce time-to-value, increase sign-to-trial and trial-to-paid conversion rates
  • Collaborate with product, marketing, and sales teams to align go-to-market efforts and drive measurable growth
  • Execute product launches and campaigns leading up to it, and bring a successful playbook you can leverage.
  • Build and manage internal and external product knowledge bases and communications for product updates
  • Be an active contributor in the development and management of customer advocacy programs such as user referral and/or affiliate programs.
  • Track campaign performance and report KPIs with precision — weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly
  • Partner with our success team to collect customer feedback through surveys, direct customer communications, and beta groups, and use it to create user stories and case studies.
  • Document campaign playbooks, and external and internal product trainings, using video (Loom), and upload to Trainual

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
About Mosaic Puzzles

Mosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. We design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the story. Our collections blend intricate art, clever cut designs, and premium craftsmanship.


We’re a fast-paced, growing startup led by former Uber and Amazon team members, and we’re looking for someone excited to move quickly and contribute ideas that make a real impact.


Check our website for more information:


Position Overview

We’re looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and results-driven Marketing Specialist to join our team. This role combines strong execution skills with analytical thinking and excellent project management.


This role supports the planning and execution of marketing initiatives across multiple channels including email, SMS, social media, and website content. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working with data, and able to manage multiple marketing projects simultaneously.


You will work closely with other company departments to execute campaigns, analyze performance, and continuously improve how customers discover and engage with our products.


Key Responsibilities


Marketing Strategy & Campaign Execution

  • Assist in the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across email, SMS, social media, website content, and seasonal promotions.
  • Coordinate campaign timelines and marketing calendars to support product launches, seasonal initiatives, and brand campaigns.
  • Support lifecycle marketing initiatives including newsletters, SMS campaigns, product launches, and promotional moments.
  • Collaborate with the team to identify marketing opportunities and propose ideas that improve campaign performance.



Content & Brand Communication

  • Write clear, engaging copy for newsletters, SMS campaigns, social media, blog posts, and other marketing materials.
  • Maintain a consistent brand voice across all marketing channels.
  • Coordinate content calendars aligned with seasonal themes, product launches, and marketing priorities.
  • Monitor social media conversations and user-generated content to identify engagement opportunities.


Digital Marketing & Analytics

  • Track and analyze campaign performance across email, SMS, social media, and website channels.
  • Interpret marketing data and provide actionable insights to improve campaign performance.
  • Assist with SEO initiatives including keyword research, content optimization, and website improvements.
  • Support customer surveys and feedback analysis to help inform product and marketing decisions.


Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Manage multiple marketing projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Work with designers, photographers, videographers, and other cross-functional partners to prepare creative briefs and campaign assets.
  • Ensure marketing initiatives are delivered on time and aligned with campaign goals.
  • Maintain a high level of organization and attention to detail across all marketing initiatives.


Requirements

  • Fluent in English (C1 level or higher). Exceptional written and spoken communication is essential.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in marketing, digital marketing, or content marketing.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing analytics and performance tracking .
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Experience working with email and SMS marketing platforms such as Mailchimp, Attentive, or similar tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive mindset with the ability to suggest ideas and take initiative.
  • Strong copywriting skills with a knack for storytelling and brand voice.
  • Experience managing social media accounts and understanding platform best practices.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing principles, including email marketing and social content strategy.
  • Knowledge of SEO is a plus.


How to Apply

Candidates must submit their resumes in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.


Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment

The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:

  • Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.
  • Process Orientation: Showing your work and thinking ahead.
  • Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.
  • Taking Responsibility: Owning your actions.
  • Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.
  • Continuous Improvement: Always seeking better ways to work.
  • Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.
  • Believing in Meritocracy: Recognizing and rewarding performance.
  • Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.

title: Business Development Manager/Director
description:
PingPong is on a mission to digitize trade, simplifying global growth for businesses. With $300B+ in payments processed, we're one of the world’s leading cross-border platforms – and we’re just getting started.

PingPong currently has 38 offices in 15 countries and over 1,500 employees. Our international presence helps businesses solve complex payment needs in every major economy across all time zones.


Now, we're scaling and looking for a BD Manager/Director to own the strategy, pipeline, and partnerships that will power our next phase of growth.


WHAT’S THE CHALLENGE?


You will take ownership for growing our customers and revenue in the region. You’ll land high-impact deals with banks, fintechs, platforms and enterprises. You’ve got the commercial sharpness to close complex deals.


WHO YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH


You’ll partner closely with our local Compliance, Product, Marketing and operations teams to build a cohesive user journey that delivers the right product to the right users, at the right time. You’ll also collaborate with colleagues across US, EU and other regions and with Group HQ teams.


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING


  • Build and execute our BD strategy across the LATAM with a focus on financial institutions, platforms and enterprise clients.
  • Maintain a high-quality pipeline across identified target verticals, focusing on high-impact deals, and think through supporting business development strategies.
  • Own the full sales cycle for closing new partners – from sourcing and qualification to leading the definition of the solution for the partner and negotiating the commercials, all the way through to go-live.
  • Pitch our API-first platform, solving real cross-border pain points.
  • Lead commercial and legal negotiations with C-level execs.
  • Work to improve our go-to-market approach, refining messaging, pricing strategy, and pitch materials based on feedback from partners and insights about competitors.
  • Collaborate internally, sharing feedback and insights from the LATAM market to product teams and senior management to inform roadmap and investment decisions.
  • Continuously refine our go-to-market playbook based on what works.
  • Be the voice of the UK market internally – and help drive what comes next.


WHAT YOU BRING


  • Track record in BD, partnerships, or enterprise sales in fintech or financial services:
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in closing complex, high-value deals with financial institutions or regulated entities
  • Fluency in the world of payments, FX, embedded finance, or APIs.
  • Strategic thinker, hands-on doer, data-driven operator.
  • Able to speak the language of product, compliance, and commercial teams.


WHO YOU ARE


  • Educated with a relevant degree in Business, Finance, or a related field. A master's degree is a plus.
  • Customer-focused, you can’t imagine working in any other way, and it’s the only way to achieve our goals.
  • Equally at home in both strategic planning and hands-on execution, ideally with experience in start-up/scale-up as well as larger organisations.
  • Ability to drill down, persistent and never-give-up spirit.
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop and execute high-impact business development strategies.
  • Strong consultative sales approach and experience negotiating with enterprise C-level executives.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills – able to influence internal and external stakeholders


PingPong is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer with a global culture that embraces diversity.

  • We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment.

description:

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. title: Marketing & Website Coordinator (Virtual Assistant)
description:
Job Title: Marketing & Website Coordinator (Virtual Assistant)

Company : Elevated Tahoe Properties

Location : Remote


About Us

Elevated Tahoe Properties manages high-touch short-term rental and property portfolios focused on guest experience, operational excellence, and high-performing marketing that drives direct bookings. We’re hiring a proactive, creative, and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to support our website, digital marketing, social media, and lead generation efforts.

Our Company Culture:

  • We are a fun, young company growing quickly
  • We value open communication and adding in humor whenever possible
  • Our team is self driven and empowered to handle their own responsibilities without being micromanaged
  • We inspire each other to become the best version of ourselves we can possibly become. 
  • We lead by example and use positive reinforcement to inspire others to strive for personal and professional greatness.

Role Summary

You will be responsible for helping us grow our online presence and increase direct vacation rental bookings through website updates, landing page creation, lead capture strategy, email marketing, and social media content support. This role requires strong design instincts, attention to detail, marketing experience, and a solid understanding of WordPress, Elementor, and basic website coding.


Key Responsibilities


  • Manage and update our WordPress website using Elementor
  • Build and optimize landing pages designed to drive bookings and capture leads
  • Improve website layout, visuals, and user experience to support conversion goals
  • Help increase traffic to the website through organic and campaign-based marketing efforts
  • Develop compelling, conversion-focused copywriting that incorporates SEO best practices for all web and marketing assets
  • Edit and prepare social media content including short-form video, photos, graphics, and captions
  • Schedule and publish social media posts across relevant platforms
  • Monitor inbound leads and help organize follow-up and lead nurturing workflows
  • Create and manage nurture email campaigns for existing guests, past guests, and new leads
  • Support list building, audience segmentation, and email campaign improvements
  • Assist with marketing asset creation for promotions, campaigns, and seasonal offers
  • Maintain brand consistency across website pages, email marketing, and social media content
  • Collaborate with leadership on ideas to improve direct bookings, lead generation, and guest engagement

Qualifications


  • Proven experience in digital marketing, website management, or lead generation
  • Strong hands-on experience with WordPress and Elementor
  • Strong design skills with an eye for clean, polished, high-converting content
  • Experience editing social media video and photo content
  • Experience with email marketing platforms and nurture campaigns
  • Comfortable creating landing pages and understanding basic conversion strategy
  • Decent to strong website coding basics, including familiarity with HTML/CSS and light troubleshooting
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple moving pieces
  • Able to work independently, take initiative, and bring creative solutions to the table
  • Familiarity with Asana or similar project management tools

Non‑Negotiable Requirements

  • Reliable backup power (UPS or generator) to prevent downtime during outages
  • Dual monitors for efficient multitasking
  • Backup internet (secondary wired connection or mobile hotspot) with stable speeds
  • Quiet, dedicated workspace and dependable computer 

Preferred

  • Experience with the Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro) or similar creative tools
  • Strong video editing proficiency for creating engaging short-form content
  • Deep understanding of social media marketing trends, algorithms, and best practices
  • Experience working with hospitality, vacation rentals, real estate, or travel brands

Required Days/Hours

  • Monday - Friday 8AM to 5PM Pacific Time (1 hour unpaid Lunch Break)


Compensation Target:

$950 per month + monthly KPI bonus / 40 hours per week — salary negotiable based on experience.

What We Offer

  • Remote role supporting a growing vacation rental and hospitality brand
  • Opportunity to directly impact bookings, lead generation, and brand growth
  • Creative, collaborative team environment with room to contribute ideas and improve systems


How to Apply (only email applications will be considered)


Email :

Subject : The Marketing & Website Coordinator Your Team Needs


Include:

  • Your Resume/CV
  • ONE OF (listed in order of preference):
  • A link to your personal portfolio website
  • A comprehensive PDF format portfolio document
  • At list of at least 5 links of design and marketing work you’ve completed
  • Pre-Screening Form:
  • Internet Speed Verification:

Note : Please only submit a screenshot of the speed test results.

  • DISC Assessment:

  Note : Please only submit a screenshot of the DISC assessment results graph.

  • A 2–3 minute video that includes:

-Brief intro and summary of your experience

-Why you’re the ideal candidate for this position

-Your top 3 skills that make you an excellent marketing and design coordinator


﻿Only applicants who follow these instructions exactly and demonstrate strong attention to detail will be considered.


Thank you and we look forward to working with you!


~ Elevated Tahoe Properties Team

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Native Teams is a global platform for work payments and employment. Beyond managing payroll, compliance, and taxes, we integrate financial tools to maximise the value of every work payment, worldwide.


We are expanding our global team and looking for a Business Development Manager to bring their wider knowledge and help us get our product and service more widely known and used.


In this role, you will play a key role in driving new business and revenue growth by managing the full sales cycle from outbound outreach to discovery, solution design, negotiation, and closing. You will work closely with prospective clients to understand their needs, educate them on Native Teams' solutions, and guide them through the decision-making and onboarding process. Your goal is to acquire new customers and expand revenue within assigned markets and ICPs.


Would you like to take on a new challenge in the field of sales in a successful, fast-growing global start-up?


Location: Remote

Salary range: Flexible


Key Responsibilities


Outbound & Pipeline Generation

  • Proactively identify and engage prospective clients through outbound outreach, networking, events, and other channels.
  • Execute outbound strategies tailored to defined ICPs and market segments.
  • Research accounts for understanding business context, hiring plans, and potential use cases.


Inbound Handling

  • Take qualified inbound requests and convert them into active opportunities.
  • Respond promptly and professionally in line with internal SLAs.
  • Run a structured qualification to assess fit and readiness.


Discovery & Consultative Selling

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls to understand client goals, blockers, compliance considerations, and service requirements.
  • Educate prospects on how Native Teams supports global employment, payroll, and work payments.
  • Present tailored solutions, product overviews, and value propositions to multiple stakeholders.


Solution Design & Pricing

title: Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP Databases
description:
Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP Databases


Location: Ukraine, Armenia, Moldova, Brazil(Remote)


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Data Engineer to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


About the Role


We're hiring a Senior DBA to own the database layer across our production systems — OLTP relational databases as the operational store and an OLAP columnar database for analytics. Data flows between them via a CDC pipeline (Debezium → Kafka) managed by our infrastructure team. You'll own what's on both ends: schema design, data modeling, query performance, and analytics enablement.

This is a high-ownership role. You'll be the technical authority on how our data is structured, how it performs, and how schema changes propagate safely from OLTP to OLAP stores. You'll work closely with application teams, data consumers, and the infrastructure team that operates the CDC pipeline.


What You'll Own

  • OLTP schema design: Data modeling, indexing strategies, migration planning, and performance tuning across multiple database clusters
  • OLAP data modeling: Table design, materialized views, partitioning, and query optimization for analytics workloads
  • Schema evolution: Coordinating schema changes with the infrastructure team to ensure safe propagation through the CDC pipeline
  • Query performance: Profiling, optimization, and capacity planning across both OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Data integrity: Validation, reconciliation, and monitoring to ensure consistency between OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Technical leadership: Standards for schema management, review processes, mentoring, and cross-team collaboration


Tech Stack

  • OLTP: Aurora MySQL 8.0 (multiple clusters, multi-AZ)
  • OLAP: ClickHouse 25.x
  • CDC Pipeline: Debezium 3.3.2 → Kafka 4.0 → ClickHouse
  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
  • Cloud: AWS (EKS, RDS, S3)


Requirements

  • 5+ years as a DBA or data engineer, 2+ in a senior/lead role
  • Strong experience with OLTP relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or similar) — schema design, indexing, query optimization, replication, migrations
  • Strong experience with OLAP/columnar databases (ClickHouse, Vertica, Greenplum, Druid, Doris, or similar) — table design, materialized views, partitioning, query optimization Deep SQL expertise across both transactional and analytical query patterns
  • Experience with schema migration strategies in environments with downstream consumers (CDC, ETL, replication)
  • Familiarity with data consistency challenges between OLTP and OLAP systems



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Debezium or CDC systems — understanding how schema changes affect downstream pipelines
  • Healthcare data or regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC2)
  • Data quality frameworks — validation, reconciliation, anomaly detection
  • dbt, Airflow, or similar transformation/orchestration tools
  • Performance benchmarking and capacity planning for OLAP databases
  • Experience with AWS RDS/Aurora operational features — Parameter Groups, Performance Insights.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Data Engineering Team Lead (Remoto)

Principais Responsabilidades:

title: Integration Analyst
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Esta vaga atenderá nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar como Integration Analyst , apoiando iniciativas estratégicas de integração de sistemas e desenvolvimento em nuvem.
  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir soluções utilizando .NET (C#) , aplicando boas práticas de arquitetura, SOLID e Design Patterns .
  • Criar, consumir e manter APIs REST , garantindo segurança, escalabilidade e performance.
  • Implementar e sustentar soluções em Azure , utilizando serviços como Azure Functions, App Services, Storage, Service Bus, Key Vault e Application Insights .
  • Trabalhar com integração de sistemas entre múltiplas plataformas , incluindo ambientes corporativos e parceiros externos.
  • Atuar com CI/CD , versionamento e automação utilizando GitHub e GitHub Actions .
  • Implementar e manter testes automatizados (unitários e de integração).
  • Garantir segurança de APIs , utilizando padrões como OAuth2 e JWT .
  • Produzir e manter documentação técnica clara e estruturada .
  • Colaborar com times técnicos internos, stakeholders de negócio e parceiros externos em um ambiente corporativo global.
  • Atuar em times Agile , participando de cerimônias Scrum e/ou SAFe.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência mínima de 4 anos com desenvolvimento .NET (C#) .
  • Vivência prática com metodologias ágeis (Scrum e/ou SAFe).
  • Experiência comprovada com Azure Cloud , incluindo:
  • Azure Functions
  • Azure App Services
  • Azure Storage
  • Azure Key Vault
  • Azure Service Bus
  • Application Insights
  • Certificação AZ-104 – Azure Administrator .
  • Experiência com controle de versão (Git/GitHub) e pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions).
  • Experiência em integração de sistemas e desenvolvimento de APIs REST .
  • Conhecimento em segurança de APIs (OAuth2, JWT).
  • Vivência com testes automatizados (unit e integration tests).
  • Aplicação consistente de Clean Code , Design Patterns e princípios SOLID.
  • Inglês avançado (escrita e conversação).


Será um destaque no seu perfil

  • Experiência com Salesforce , incluindo:
  • Lightning Web Components (LWC)
  • Apex Classes e Triggers
  • Flows
  • Experience Cloud (Builder)
  • Integração com APIs externas
  • Salesforce Commerce Cloud
  • Flosum
  • Conhecimento de objetos padrão e customizados no Salesforce.
  • Certificação AZ-204 – Developing Solutions for Microsoft Azure .
  • Experiência com publicação de aplicativos mobile (Apple Store e Google Play).
  • Familiaridade com Google Firebase .
  • Experiência prévia em ambientes corporativos multinacionais .
  • Certificações adicionais em integração ou tecnologias de desenvolvimento.


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa. A posição é oferecida em regime 100% Home Office , com atuação para um time global e ambiente ágil.

title: ASM Team Lead
description:
Responsibilities

  • Lead the ASM team in daily coordination, prioritization, and escalation management.

  • Ensure compliance with processes and controls, applying ITIL/ SDLC best practices.
  • Present monthly results (KPIs/SLAs) to IT and Business leadership.
  • Support operational activities when necessary.


Success Indicators (KPIs)

  • Application availability and stability (uptime).
  • MTTR reduction and incident recurrence reduction.
  • SLA/SLO performance.
  • Change quality (low rollback/post release incident rate).
  • Operational efficiency: backlog reduction, productivity improvements, automation.
  • Internal customer satisfaction (IT/Business).


Mandatory Requirements

  • 8+ years leading IT solution delivery (ASM, AMS, Application Operations, or related fields).
  • Proven experience in critical incident management, prioritization, and executive communication.
  • Experience with multi-vendor environments and enterprise ecosystems (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft).
  • Strong knowledge of ITIL (Incident, Problem, Change, Knowledge) and SDLC.
  • Ability to mentor teams, run operational ceremonies, and present operational metrics.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred (Computer Science, Systems, Engineering, Business/Finance).

title: Senior Director of Marketing, Edtech
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We’re seeking a results-oriented Senior Director of Marketing to lead global marketing and brand strategies for JoVE’s education and science research solutions. The ideal candidate will set the strategic vision, proactively develop and oversee the execution of data-driven programs to drive demand, accelerate revenue growth, and deepen brand engagement across educators, researchers, and librarians worldwide.


Responsibilities:


  • Develop and own the global marketing and brand strategy with a primary focus on generating qualified leads and converting them into meaningful engagement actions, including trial requests and product adoption.
  • Lead and scale a high-performing global marketing team of 20+ specialists across Campaigns, Outreach, Communications, and Events, owning performance and delivery against KPIs.
  • Drive initiatives that strengthen brand recognition and awareness while positioning JoVE as a go-to resource for education and science research.
  • Design and execute audience engagement strategies that attract, nurture, and convert prospects into trial users and active leads.
  • Plan and oversee the execution of integrated, multi-channel demand generation campaigns including email, social, webinars, events, and thought leadership.
  • Establish clear KPIs, and conversion metrics; monitor ROI and funnel impact, and continuously optimize programs to improve lead quality and conversion rates.


Requirements :


  • 10+ years of experience in marketing and brand. Experience in EdTech, academic publishing or SaaS is preferred.
  • 7+ years of management experience, successfully leading high-performing teams in a global environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to proactively develop and execute innovative marketing programs that generate leads, convert them into engaged users (e.g., trials, demos, or similar engagement actions), and drive revenue growth.
  • Strong experience managing integrated, multi-channel marketing programs across email, social, events, webinars, content, and thought leadership.
  • Experience with Hubspot and Salesforce is required.
  • Results-driven, proactive, and thrives in a fast paced environment.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Junte-se à nossa equipe como professor de inglês remoto!

Na Flyover Idiomas, nosso diferencial está no processo de junção de alunos e professores, que visa aproveitar suas semelhanças, incluindo experiência e personalidade.

Estamos à procura de pessoas dedicadas e entusiasmadas para se juntarem à nossa equipe como professores de inglês remoto. Esta posição oferece a conveniência de trabalhar de qualquer lugar com horários flexíveis.


Sobre nós:  Somos uma escola de idiomas online comprometida em oferecer ensino de inglês de alta qualidade para alunos de todas as idades e contextos. Nossa missão é ensinar os alunos através de experiências de aprendizagem personalizadas, utilizando a abordagem comunicativa, com foco na fluência mais do que na precisão, selecionando materiais autênticos e relevantes, e integrando todas as quatro habilidades.


Visão geral da posição

  • Lecionar aulas de inglês, principalmente particulares ou em pequenos grupos.
  • Desenvolver planos de aula e atividades envolventes que atendam a diferentes necessidades de aprendizagem e níveis de proficiência, usando a abordagem comunicativa, focada na autonomia do aluno e na personalização da aula.
  • Participar de treinamentos, reuniões com nossos coordenadores e projetos diversos.
  • Fornecer feedback construtivo e ajudar os alunos a melhorar suas habilidades linguísticas.
  • Enviar relatórios das aulas para manter seus alunos e a escola atualizados sobre o andamento das mesmas.
  • Promover um ambiente de aprendizagem confortável e encorajador com foco no sucesso do alu no.


Formato

  • Contratação: Contrato com Microempreendedor Individual (MEI)
  • Local : Remoto
  • Carga Horária: Você define a sua própria agenda


Requisitos

  • Proficiência em inglês (mínimo C1)
  • Bacharel em Inglês, Educação, Linguística ou áreas similares (certificação TESOL/TEFL é um diferencial).
  • Experiência comprovada no ensino de inglês como segunda língua, seja online ou em sala de aula.
  • Disponibilidade de pelo menos 25 horas/semana, com alguns horários após as 17h (horário de São Paulo).
  • Habilidades de comunicação e de relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Conexão de internet estável, computador, webcam, espaço de trabalho privado e silencioso.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de ensino online.
  • CNPJ / MEI ativo.


Por que se juntar à nós?

  • Flexibilidade: Trabalhe de qualquer lugar com um horário flexível que se adapte ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Impacto: Fazer a diferença na vida dos alunos, ajudando-os a atingir seus objetivos de aprendizagem.
  • Crescimento Profissional: Acesso a oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e treinamento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades de ensino.
  • Comunidade de Apoio: Junte-se a uma equipe de educadores que se dedicam ao sucesso dos alunos e à melhoria contínua.

title: Meitu Campus Ambassador (Analytics Track)
description:
Remote Work, Part-time, Internship


We’re looking for Campus Strategy Analysts! You will help us decode user behavior, spot local trends, and turn campus-level data insights into business decisions that shape products for millions of young users worldwide.

What you’ll do:

● Observe local trends: Track how AI and imaging apps are used around you—what’s hot, what’s not. Run surveys, conduct interviews, and gather real data to give our global strategy a local voice.

● Analyze user behavior: Go deep into how your peers interact with visual tech. Spot pain points, map user journeys, and propose clear, actionable improvements—backed by data.

● Co-create user profiles: Help us build smarter user models. Use text mining or simple AI tools to analyze interviews, social comments, and feedback—turning raw input into refined insights.

● Deliver strategic insights: Transform your observations into sharp reports and presentations that can actually shape how we grow worldwide.

We’re looking for someone who is:

● A data-savvy observer: Naturally curious about the “why” behind behaviors. You spot patterns in everyday life and can structure your findings clearly.

● A user-obsessed explorer: Always noticing how friends use apps—what works, what frustrates them, what they wish existed.

● A structured thinker: Able to take messy, real-world info and turn it into logical, compelling insights—not just data, but stories that drive decisions.

Bonus if you have:

● Academic or project experience in economics, statistics, computer science, market research, psychology, or related fields.

● Lived overseas and have a genuine interest in regional youth culture and behavior (e.g., North America, Southeast Asia, Latin America).

● Led or contributed to user research, market analysis, or business case studies—and know how to systemize what you learn.


What You’ll Get

Co-creation & Growth with Meitu Team

● Early access to product features and training sessions

● Workshops on social media, product, or design

Rewards & Credit System

We’ll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!

Redeem credits for:

● Annual Meitu products membership

● “Meitu Elite Campus Ambassador” Certificate + internship reference

● Meitu Special Deisgn

● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership

● Summer Internship Offer

● Greenlight for graduate hires interview (skip some interview rounds and get priority hiring after graduation)


About Meitu

Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.


Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357.HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.


At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Analista de qualidade sênior
description:
Analista de Qualidade Sênior


Sobre a Empresa: A Syonet é uma empresa de tecnologia especializada no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais voltadas para o setor automotivo, com foco em concessionárias. Através de sistemas de CRM, ferramentas de gestão e inteligência artificial, a Syonet promove a transformação digital, otimizando processos, melhorando a experiência do cliente e

proporcionando insights estratégicos baseados em dados para aumentar a eficiência e os resultados das empresas do setor.


Sobre o cargo: Como QA Sênior você será referência estratégica e técnica dentro da Squad, além da confiabilidade de nossos produtos. Liderando a estratégia de qualidade, definindo processos que antecipam riscos e garantem entregas de alto impacto. Será responsável por colaborar com

Tech Leads e Arquitetos para integrar a qualidade em todo o ciclo de vida do software (SDLC). Além de dominar testes manuais e automatizados, atuará como mentor do time, disseminando boas práticas, otimizando a base de conhecimento e elevando o padrão técnico da organização.


Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Desenvolver, manter e otimizar scripts e frameworks de testes automatizados para aumentar a eficiência do ciclo de entrega;
  • Atuar como referência técnica (mentor) para desenvolvedores e QAs menos experientes, apoiando decisões junto a Tech Leads e Arquitetos;
  • Planejar e executar testes funcionais, integrados, regressão e performance, garantindo que os requisitos do projeto sejam atendidos integralmente;
  • Estruturar a documentação de módulos e funcionalidades na Base de Conhecimento, assegurando a rastreabilidade e a confiabilidade dos testes;
  • Identificar gargalos nos processos de desenvolvimento e implementar métricas de qualidade para monitorar a saúde do produto.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Proficiência na área da Qualidade de Software. (experiência mínima de 5 anos);
  • Graduação concluída na área de TI;
  • Domínio em ferramentas de automação (Playwright, Cypress ou equivalentes);
  • Conhecimento em Postgres e linguagem SQL para a realização de consultas e validação de dados;
  • Experiência prática em testes de APIs (REST/SOAP) com Postman, SoapUI, Insomnia ou ferramentas similares;
  • Experiência com testes Mobile;
  • Experiência em linguagem de Programação (JavaScript, Typescript);
  • Conhecimento em padrões de projetos;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de Observabilidade (Grafana, DataDog ou similares);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de CI/CD como Gitlab.


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Vivência na integração de testes automatizados em pipelines de deploy contínuo;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de testes de desempenho como JMeter, Gatling ou k6;
  • Noções de testes de vulnerabilidades e segurança da informação;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas e uso de IA generativa;
  • Conhecimento em mensageria;
  • Possuir certificações como CTFL (ISTQB), CTAL ou especializações em Automação de Testes.

description:

Principais Responsabilidades:


Atuação Estratégica e Técnica

  • Atuar como engenheiro(a) sênior, participando diretamente do desenvolvimento (design, codificação e entrega de features).
  • Liderar o desenho e evolução da arquitetura de dados, garantindo escalabilidade, confiabilidade e performance.
  • Trabalhar com tecnologias modernas como Snowflake, Databricks e serviços em cloud (AWS/Azure).
  • Gerenciar e desenvolver o time, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de alta performance.
  • Incentivar o crescimento técnico e de carreira dos engenheiros.
  • Atuar em conjunto com Product Managers na descoberta e definição de soluções, garantindo alinhamento com necessidades do negócio.
  • Definir e garantir boas práticas de arquitetura, engenharia e metodologias ágeis.
  • Gerenciar e reduzir dívida técnica da plataforma.
  • Liderar iniciativas de análise, planejamento e execução de projetos de dados.
  • Garantir entregas consistentes e alinhadas com os objetivos estratégicos.


Responsabilidades do Dia a Dia:

  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados e processos de ETL (Airbyte, Fivetran, Azure Data Factory).
  • Construir e manter infraestrutura de dados robusta e escalável.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com times de dados, produto, engenharia e stakeholders de negócio.
  • Gerenciar infraestrutura com práticas modernas (Terraform, Ansible, Azure Application Insights).
  • Garantir governança, qualidade e confiabilidade dos dados.
  • Atuar na operação de ambientes produtivos, incluindo suporte a incidentes críticos.
  • Promover inovação contínua e adoção de novas tecnologias, incluindo uso de IA no ciclo de desenvolvimento.


Requisitos Técnicos (Obrigatórios)

  • Experiência sólida com pipelines de dados, ETL e ambientes produtivos.
  • Experiência com Airbyte, Fivetran, Snowflake, Databricks e Azure Data Factory.
  • Forte domínio de SQL e modelagem de dados (incluindo grandes volumes).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI como Power BI e Sigma.
  • Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Ansible).
  • Programação em Python (diferencial: Scala).
  • Experiência com Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Conhecimento em data lakes, bancos relacionais, NoSQL e OLAP.
  • Boa comunicação e visão orientada a produto.

title: Senior Network Security Engineer
description:
The Network Security Engineer is responsible for protecting an organization’s networks and data from cyber threats. This role involves designing, implementing, and maintaining security infrastructure (firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, VPNs, etc.) and monitoring the network for vulnerabilities or incidents. The engineer will play a critical role in upholding Zero Trust security principles and ensuring high availability and integrity of network services in a dynamic, cloud-enabled environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Security Infrastructure Management: Configure, deploy, and maintain network security systems (firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN gateways, encryption devices) to safeguard internal networks and cloud environments.
  • Threat Monitoring & Incident Response: Monitor network traffic and logs for suspicious activities; promptly investigate and respond to security incidents or breaches to minimize impact.
  • Vulnerability Assessment: Conduct regular security audits, vulnerability scans, and penetration tests to identify and remediate network weaknesses. Implement patches and updates to address vulnerabilities and ensure systems are protected against emerging threats.
  • Access Control & Policies: Enforce access controls and network segmentation (supporting a Zero Trust Network Access model) by administering firewalls and network access control lists. Develop and update network security policies, standards, and procedures to align with best practices and compliance requirements.
  • Collaboration & Advisory: Work closely with IT infrastructure teams, application developers, and security architects to integrate security measures into new projects and systems. Provide guidance on secure network design and educate team members on security best practices.
  • Documentation & Compliance: Maintain detailed documentation of configurations, incidents, and changes. Ensure all network security measures comply with relevant regulations and industry standards (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS) and assist in preparing for security audits.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • Technical Skills: Strong understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, etc.) and hands-on experience with network security technologies (firewalls such as Palo Alto/Cisco/Fortinet, IDS/IPS, VPN solutions, SIEM tools). Proficiency in configuring and managing firewalls and routing/switching equipment in complex networks.
  • Security Expertise: Knowledge of cybersecurity principles , threat landscape, and best practices (e.g., Zero Trust architecture, defense-in-depth, encryption, secure network design ). Ability to perform log analysis, intrusion detection, malware analysis basics, and incident handling.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for diagnosing network and security issues. Ability to respond effectively under pressure during security incidents or outages.
  • Communication & Teamwork: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders, and provide user training or guidance on security policies when needed.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced/Cloud Security: Experience with cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP networking and security services) or secure network design in hybrid cloud environments . Familiarity with SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) frameworks or software-defined networking is a plus.
  • Automation & Scripting: Scripting or automation skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell) to automate network/security tasks and improve efficiency in security operations.
  • Advanced Education: Master’s degree in Cybersecurity or Information Systems.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in network security, cybersecurity engineering, or a related IT infrastructure security role. Proven track record implementing and managing firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs, and performing security monitoring and incident response in an enterprise or managed services environment.

Certifications:

  • Industry Certifications: Professional certifications are highly advantageous . Preferred certifications include CISSP, CISM (for security management knowledge) or CEH, GIAC (for technical security skills). Vendor-specific certifications such as Palo Alto Networks PCNSE/PCNSA are also valuable and demonstrate expertise in relevant technologies.

title: ESPECIALISTA SISTEMAS SAP TM

O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra. Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 132 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos.


Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.


O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade

  • Realizar o suporte as áreas de Supply chain, garantindo a correta execução de seus processos;
  • Fazer alinhamentos e governanças dos atendimentos de chamados com as áreas clientes e TI, buscando melhoras o suporte realizado as áreas de negócio;
  • Elaborar estudos de viabilidade técnica, bem como especificações funcionais e técnicas para soluções de tratativas de causa raiz para erros sistêmicos;
  • Acompanhar os status das demandas e realizar follow-up dos planos de ação, garantindo a execução dos testes pelas áreas de negócio.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com nossos clientes para entender suas necessidades específicas e encontrar as melhores soluções dentro do módulo SAP TM.
  • Apoiar key users, conduzindo treinamentos e orientação funcional.


REQUISITOS

  • Graduação em TI, Ciências da Computação ou Análise de Sistemas;
  • Necessário:
  • Conhecimento em suporte ao módulo SAP TM (Transportation Management)
  • Experiência em suporte AMS no módulo TM nos processos de Planejamento de Fretes através do Sistema SAP TM;
  • Conhecimento aprofundado nos processos de Planejamento de transporte, Freight Order, Freight Agreement e Charge Calculation.
  • Diferencial:
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de desenvolvimento BOPF;
  • Experiência no suporte ao módulo SAP LES/TRA;
  • Conhecimento nas diferentes versões do módulo TM (S4/Hanna);

  • Plano de Saúde

description:

Hands-on experience building reports and dashboards in Microsoft Power BI.

Experience working with data orchestration platforms such as Data Hub.

Strong experience with SIEM platforms (e.g.,Sentinel).

Hands-on experience with SOAR platforms and playbook development.

Solid understanding of endpoint security tools (EDR/XDR) or BeyondTrust

Experience with scripting and automation (e.g., Python, PowerShell, REST APIs).

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent communication skills and ability to work in cross-functional

  • Join a collaborative, innovation-driven engineering culture .
  • Competitive compensation and long-term growth opportunities .
  • Opportunity to contribute to high-impact, scalable software solutions .

title: Marketing Operations Manager (with Marketo)
description:

From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

We’re seeking a Marketing Operations Manager to own and evolve our Marketo ecosystem. This role will take full responsibility for the platform, improve how it’s structured and used, and partner closely with our Marketing team and Salesforce Admin to drive scalable, reliable execution. This person will immediately stabilize and improve the system, while enabling others on the team to operate more effectively.

We expect East/West Coast/etc. work hours.


As Our Marketing Operations Manager, You Will:

  • Own day-to-day execution in Marketo (email sends, landing pages, forms, smart campaigns, programs, UTM parameters)
  • Drive Marketo platform architecture, governance, and best practices
  • Improve program structure and operational standards
  • Design and maintain scalable campaign frameworks
  • Optimize lead lifecycle, scoring, routing, and sync with Salesforce
  • Act as the primary Marketo expert and point of escalation
  • Partner with the Salesforce Admin on data model, integrations, and automation
  • Identify gaps, inefficiencies, and technical debt
  • Support and mentor other Marketo users on the team
  • Contribute to longer-term marketing operations strategy and tooling decisions
  • Manage the integrations of additional tools like On24, ZoomInfo and other items in the MarTech stack
  • Maintain database health through smart list logic, segmentation, and deduplication strategies.
  • Track KPIs for campaign performance, conversion rates, and lead funnel progression.
  • Recommend and implement improvements to marketing automation workflows and program efficiency.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in a marketing operations or marketing automation role.
  • Proficient in Marketo ; Marketo Certified Expert (MCE) preferred. Hands-on, end-to-end usage as well as administrative support are equally critical. Experience with HubSpot is also preferred.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM ; admin experience highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of marketing automation best practices including deliverability, nurture strategies, and lead scoring.
  • Experience with marketing data analysis, segmentation, and reporting.
  • Familiarity with UTM strategy, campaign attribution models, and web analytics tools.
  • Experience with integrations, webhooks, or APIs
  • Strong troubleshooting and systems-thinking skills
  • Ability to thrive in a collaborative, metrics-driven, and fast-paced team environment.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2+/C1 or higher).


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes a competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.

description:

Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $1,000 - $1,400 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a data-driven Part-Time Email Marketer  to own the end-to-end retention strategy for two sister companies: a visual, custom-framing e-commerce site and a B2B wholesale moulding supplier.


You will be responsible for turning one-time buyers into repeat customers (D2C) and nurturing long-term professional relationships with artists, photographers, and businesses (B2B).

  • Performance Reporting:  Track and report on Email-Attributed Revenue and List Growth monthly.


Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Platform Expertise:  3+ years of advanced proficiency in e-commerce email marketing platforms is a must.
  • Copywriting:  Ability to toggle between \"Inspiring & Aesthetic\" (D2C) and \"Professional & Direct\" (B2B).
  • Design Lite:  Proficiency with visual design tools to create or edit email templates that align with the brand identity.
  • B2B Experience:  Experience with \"Sales Enablement\" style emails (plain-text, personal feel) meant to drive inquiries for high-volume wholesale orders.
  • Data Literacy:  Deep understanding of how to use email data to inform the wider growth strategy.


Bonus Points:

  • Experience in the home decor, photography, or art industries.
  • Understanding of SMS marketing integration.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to drive retention and growth strategies for a fast-evolving e-commerce and wholesale business.


Commitment: Part-Time (around 10-15 hours a week), Long-term, Overlapping with PST working hours.


*Please note our partner is only looking for dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

Contract

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced cybersecurity consultant to lead strategic clients in

title: Coordenador de Order To Cash
description:
Coordenador (a) de Order To Cash | Híbrido - São Paulo


Estamos em busca de um Coordenador de OTC (Order to Cash) . Este profissional será responsável por liderar um time em um momento de transformação, garantindo confiança, autonomia e desenvolvimento da equipe. O papel exige forte capacidade estratégica, mas também disposição para atuar no operacional quando necessário, sendo um verdadeiro backup do time . O desafio principal é gestão de pessoas , com foco em engajamento, crescimento e melhoria contínua dos processos.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Gestão e desenvolvimento da equipe , promovendo autonomia e direcionamento.
  • Estruturar processos e implementar melhorias, incluindo planos de contingência.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e estratégica, garantindo suporte operacional quando necessário.
  • Importante conhecer todo processo operacional para gerenciar todo o ciclo Order to Cash , incluindo:
  • Cadastro e registro de clientes (novos e recorrentes).
  • Análise de crédito e definição de condições de pagamento.
  • Faturamento e emissão de boletos (PIX, boleto bancário).

  • Participar do fechamento contábil mensal.


Requisitos Técnicos


  • Excel avançado (mandatório).
  • Experiência sólida em processos OTC, análise de crédito, cobrança, contas a receber e faturamento.
  • Conhecimento em SAP (configuração e operação).
  • Noções fiscais e contábeis para interação com áreas correlatas.

  • Inglês avançado.
  • Formação superior completa (desejável pós-graduação).


Competências Comportamentais


  • Perfil autônomo , organizado e proativo.
  • Capacidade de liderança e desenvolvimento de pessoas.
  • Comunicação clara e interpessoal positivo.
  • Pensamento estratégico aliado à capacidade de execução.
  • Senso de urgência e habilidade para lidar com desafios.


Diferenciais


  • Experiência em ambientes com crescimento acelerado .
  • Histórico de implementação de melhorias e desenvolvimento de equipes.
  • Espanhol (desejável).

description:
Sobre o Grupo Creatonomy


O Grupo Creatonomy é um ecossistema inovador focado na creator economy, com empresas como a Topshare, que impulsionam criadores de conteúdo e influenciadores digitais. Buscamos um profissional dinâmico para integrar nossa equipe e atuar de forma estratégica na comunicação e relacionamento com nossa comunidade de criadores e parceiros.

O(A) Social Media & CRM Specialist será responsável por fortalecer a presença digital das empresas do grupo Creatonomy e nutrir o relacionamento com nossos criadores através de estratégias de conteúdo e comunicação personalizadas. Este profissional terá um papel fundamental na construção de comunidades engajadas e na otimização da jornada dos criadores em nosso ecossistema.


Responsabilidades e Escopo de Atividades


O escopo de trabalho abrange a totalidade da estratégia de comunicação digital e relacionamento, com ênfase nas seguintes atividades:

• Planejar, criar e executar calendários de conteúdo para as redes sociais das empresas do Grupo Creatonomy (Instagram, X (Twitter), entre outras).

• Monitorar tendências, interagir com a comunidade e analisar métricas para otimizar o desempenho das publicações.

• Desenvolver estratégias de engajamento e crescimento orgânico para os perfis.


2. Estratégia de CRM e E-mail Marketing:

• Desenvolver e implementar réguas de relacionamento por e-mail para criadores de conteúdo, desde o onboarding até a fidelização.

• Criar e-mails e newsletters com conteúdo relevante, ofertas e atualizações do ecossistema Creatonomy.

• Segmentar bases de dados e analisar o desempenho das campanhas de e-mail marketing.

3. Produção de Conteúdo:

• Colaborar na criação de materiais ricos (e-books, guias, infográficos, webinars) que agreguem valor aos criadores e parceiros.

• Auxiliar na produção de conteúdo audiovisual e textual para diversas plataformas, garantindo a consistência da marca.


4. Suporte ao Ecossistema de Criadores:

• Identificar oportunidades de melhoria na experiência do criador através da comunicação.


Requisitos e Qualificações

• Experiência comprovada em gestão de redes sociais e marketing de conteúdo.

• Conhecimento ou vivência com a plataforma RD Station para e-mail marketing e automação de marketing (CRM) será considerado um diferencial.

• Habilidade em redação e comunicação, com foco em storytelling e engajamento.

• Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados e otimizar estratégias.

• Proatividade, criatividade e organização.


ATENÇÃO: REQUISITO OBRIGATÓRIO


APENAS CANDIDATOS COM PORTFÓLIO COMPROVADO DE TRABALHOS RELEVANTES EM SOCIAL MEDIA E/OU CRM DEVEM SE CANDIDATAR. CANDIDATURAS SEM PORTFÓLIO SERÃO DESCONSIDERADAS.


Informações da Vaga

• Regime de Contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)

• Remuneração: R$ 3.500,00/mês

• Local: Remoto

• Horário de Trabalho: De segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h

  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Perfil proativo, organizado e com forte senso de responsabilidade ética;

title: Graphic Designer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.

﻿

Monthly salary: $1,300 - $1,500 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Graphic Designer focused on email and lifecycle marketing creative  to join their marketing team. In this role, you will own the visual execution of their email, SMS, and promotional campaigns, working closely with retention, marketing, and creative teams to bring campaigns to life.


This is a high-output, performance-driven role. They run a structured weekly marketing calendar with multiple sends across email and SMS, so speed, organization, and strong creative instincts are critical.


What You'll Do:

Email & Lifecycle Creative

  • Design marketing emails across promotional, campaign, and automated lifecycle flows
  • Create assets for email, SMS, landing pages, and retention marketing campaigns
  • Build modular email systems that allow for quick campaign iteration
  • Translate marketing strategy into high-converting email layouts


Campaign Production

  • Execute weekly marketing calendars with multiple sends per week
  • Design creative for product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and evergreen flows
  • Collaborate with retention and marketing teams to deliver assets quickly and efficiently
  • Maintain visual consistency across all lifecycle marketing touchpoints


Lifestyle Marketing Creative

  • Design marketing assets using lifestyle photography and brand creative
  • Support marketing campaigns across email, social, and digital placements
  • Help evolve their visual storytelling across campaigns


Optimization & Iteration

  • Work closely with marketing teams to test and improve creative performance
  • Iterate quickly on creative based on campaign results
  • Contribute ideas for new creative concepts and campaign approaches


Their Marketing Workflow:

Their lifecycle marketing operates on a structured weekly campaign calendar, with multiple emails and SMS sends each week. You will work inside this framework by:

  • Designing assets aligned to weekly campaign themes
  • Creating creative that supports multiple sends across a campaign window
  • Building creative that can be reused and iterated on across lifecycle flows
  • They move fast and prioritize clear, high-impact creative that performs, not overly complex designs.


Tools & Experience:

Required

  • Figma
  • Email design systems
  • Experience designing marketing emails
  • Strong understanding of mobile-first design


Nice to Have

  • Klaviyo / Attentive experience
  • Experience with lifecycle marketing
  • Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator)
  • Understanding of e-commerce marketing and DTC brands


What They’re Looking For:

  • 3+ years of experience as a Graphic Designer with strong visual design skills, particularly focused on email and marketing content
  • Ability to produce high-quality work quickly
  • Organized and comfortable working inside structured marketing calendars
  • Experience with email marketing and promotional campaigns
  • Understanding of e-commerce and performance marketing


Bonus If You Have:

  • Experience with lifestyle or fashion brands
  • Experience designing for high-volume email marketing programs
  • Motion / light animation for marketing assets


The Type of Designer Who Thrives Here:

Someone who:

  • Moves fast
  • Understands marketing
  • Likes working inside a campaign rhythm
  • Knows that great marketing creative is about clarity and performance, not just aesthetics


Work Schedule: US Pacific Standard Time


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to design high-impact lifecycle marketing campaigns for a fast-paced e-commerce brand.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.


Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.



THE ROLE

The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers.

In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.

• Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.

• Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.

• Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.

• Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.

• Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.

• Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope.

• Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.



WHAT IT TAKES

• Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.

• Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.g., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS).

• Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.

• Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.


Be fully aligned to our core values:

• Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

• Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

• Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

• Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.



WHAT WE OFFER

• Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.

• Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.

• Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.

• Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.

• Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.

• An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.



Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

description:

Estamos em busca de um Coordenador de OTC (Order to Cash) . Este profissional será responsável por liderar um time em um momento de transformação, garantindo confiança, autonomia e desenvolvimento da equipe. title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Marketing
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Coordenação do Departamento de Marketing compreendendo Trade, Comunicação, CRM e Programa de Benefícios;
  • Planejamento do calendário anual de campanhas e eventos e elaboração de plano de marketing com o orçamento de despesas de sua área;
  • Controle financeiro;
  • Negociação com parceiros e patrocínios;
  • Interface com agência de publicidade e promoção: elaboração de briefings de campanhas, plano de mídia, comunicação interna do shopping, campanhas promocionais (mecânica, documentação, premiação, prestação de contas);
  • Responsável pela comunicação do shopping com a assessoria de imprensa: aprovação de releases e sugestão de pautas;
  • Preservar a imagem do empreendimento junto ao público em geral e lojistas;
  • Contribuir com a Gerência de Marketing, participando de reuniões sistemáticas com a equipe para avaliação de metas setoriais, acompanhamento dos indicadores de qualidade, desenvolvimento de planos de melhoria contínua e intercâmbio de informações.


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Ensino superior completo em Marketing, Comunicação, Publicidade e áreas correlatas;
  • Diferenciais: MBA em administração, comunicação, marketing, produção de eventos.
  • Pacote Office Avançado;
